sql_templates.description: Retrieve sector breadth data for last 5 sessions and identify sectors with improving Stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.name: latest_sector_data
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_dates AS (SELECT snapshot_date FROM breadth.sector_daily ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 5),
latest_breadth AS (SELECT sd.sector, sd.snapshot_date, sd.pct_above_50dma, sd.change_5d, ma.stage2_pct
FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above ma ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
WHERE sd.snapshot_date IN (SELECT snapshot_date FROM latest_dates)),
stage_two_improving AS (SELECT DISTINCT sector
FROM scores.stage_snapshots
WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND stage = 'STAGE_2'),
final_selection AS (SELECT lb.sector, lb.snapshot_date, lb.pct_above_50dma, lb.change_5d, lb.stage2_pct
FROM latest_breadth lb
JOIN stage_two_improving si ON lb.sector = si.sector
ORDER BY lb.snapshot_date DESC)
SELECT * FROM final_selection LIMIT 50

synthesis_guidance: ['Focus on broad sector improvement and stock candidates for TradingView.', 'Highlight sectors with the greatest Stage 2 participation increases.']
title: Sector Breadth Rotation Watchlist Variant 0923
